a7-DlDDW-U1LWnW1LtH3hw.zh: 宏都拉斯疫情持續,今年截至9/23累計報告280例確定病例、22 例死亡,較去年全年報告114例增幅達145.6%,目前該國疫苗覆蓋率約80%,當局呼籲⺠眾落實常規疫苗接種。 哈薩克自2026年以來累計報告76例確定病例,其中以88%為未接種疫苗的兒童為主,當局推測較去年同期下降2.8倍,可能與該國持續進行疫苗接種和兒童補接種措施有關。當局亦將持續加強接種疫苗等衛教宣導。
a7-DlDDW-U1LWnW1LtH3hw.en: Pertussis transmission continues in Honduras. As of 23 September this year, 280 confirmed cases and 22 deaths have been reported, an increase of 145.6% over the 114 cases reported for the whole of last year. The country's vaccination coverage is approximately 80%, and authorities urge the public to follow routine vaccination schedules. Kazakhstan has reported 76 confirmed cases since the start of 2026, 88% of them unvaccinated children. Authorities estimate that cases are 2.8 times lower than in the same period last year, possibly due to ongoing vaccination and catch-up immunisation of children. Authorities will continue to strengthen vaccination and health education.

cSO0yLK2IVMgI1EvJ90BQA.en: The outbreak in Honduras continues to expand, with more than 180 cases reported cumulatively and 14 deaths. Most cases are infants under 1 year who had not completed vaccination. Authorities continue to monitor the situation and to promote catch-up vaccination for pregnant women and young children in response to this wave of the outbreak.

fDj48FwAISQbs1MyTOdAuQ.en: Honduras reported its first case on 21 May: a 40-year-old man, assessed as an imported case from neighbouring Guatemala. From December 2025 through 13 May, Guatemala reported 6,209 confirmed cases, 7,752 probable cases and 12 deaths cumulatively. The country has issued a red alert for the outbreak. This event shows that the outbreak in Guatemala continues to expand and has produced cross-border transmission. Mexico reported 11,033 cases this year as of 22 May, mainly in Jalisco State and Mexico City. Since January 2025, this wave of the outbreak has recorded 17,641 cases and 41 deaths cumulatively, with children aged 1–4 accounting for the largest share, followed by those aged 5–9.

vPaxu9csjrYdIOHN8dblag.en: Dengue is rising in Honduras. As of week 24 this year, about 7,500 cumulative cases have been reported, the second highest in Central America. Cases are concentrated in the Central district and in San Pedro Sula. Case numbers in the Americas this year are 70% lower than in the same period last year. Dengue is also rising in Mali. So far this year, 1,918 cumulative cases (380 confirmed) have been reported, the second highest in Africa, distributed across 11 regions nationwide. In the most recent week, 52 cases (11 confirmed) were reported, with the most in Bamako and Kayes in the southwest. Across Africa, 7 countries have reported nearly 8,000 cases and 7 deaths this year, and the main recently circulating serotype is DENV-2.

MtnoDj3DtXCdMWVpRQnxxA.en: Human infections have increased in Central and South America in recent years, with human cases reported in Panama, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Mexico and other countries. In addition, Canada reported a case in an 80-year-old man in March this year who had a travel history to Costa Rica, indicating that the disease may spread through international travel and increase the risk of international transmission. The screwworm fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae can parasitize wounds or natural body cavities of humans and animals, causing myiasis. There is currently no vaccine or specific drug.
